threats.title: Weak password
threats.description: Passwords can be guessed if they are too weak

threats.title: Citizen doesn't own email address
threats.description: The user registers with an email they don't own.

threats.title: Bad actor logs in using stolen credentials
threats.description: Bad actors finds a user's email and password (through measures like phishing emails etc) and attempts to use it to log in.

diagrams.title: Reports
diagrams.placeholder: Report creation, ownership, editing and share-link access

data.name:
Citizen / Report Owner
(A1, T4/T5)
data.description: A1 Citizen. T4 logged-in citizen and T5 report owner. Can create reports and view/edit reports they created.

threats.title: Session theft grants report-owner privileges
threats.description: A stolen authenticated session could allow an attacker to act as the citizen.
threats.mitigation: Use Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite cookies, appropriate session expiration and re-authentication for sensitive actions.

data.name:
Share-link Recipient
(A2, T3)
data.description: A2 Share-link recipient. T3 unauthenticated user with a valid share token. The token grants read access to the one report it refers to.

threats.title: Share link can be forwarded
threats.description: Anyone who obtains the secret share link can use it to access the report.
threats.mitigation: Use expiring and revocable share tokens.

data.name:
List Own Reports
(E5)
data.description: E5 Report list page. Lists reports owned by the citizen and their status.

threats.title: Report list not scoped to owner
threats.description: A citizen could receive another citizen’s reports if the query is not constrained by the authenticated owner.
threats.mitigation: Derive ownership from the authenticated session and enforce it in the database query.

data.name:
Create Report
(E6)
data.description: E6 Create report page. Citizen enters date, time, location, description and images.

threats.title: Malicious image upload
threats.description: Uploaded images may contain malicious content if file type and content are not validated.
threats.mitigation: Validate file contents, restrict formats and safely process images.

threats.title: Image metadata disclosure
threats.description: Images may contain EXIF metadata such as GPS coordinates.

threats.title: Oversized image denial of service
threats.description: Large or resource-intensive images can consume storage and processing resources.
threats.mitigation: Enforce upload size, dimension and processing limits.

data.name:
View / Edit Report
(E7)
data.description: E7 View and edit report page. Report owner views and edits their report.

threats.title: Insecure direct object reference
threats.description: Changing a report identifier could expose another citizen’s report without object-level authorisation.
threats.mitigation: Perform server-side ownership checks on every report request.

threats.title: Editing closed reports
threats.description: A crafted request could bypass a hidden edit button if the server does not enforce report state.
threats.mitigation: Reject updates when the report is closed.

threats.title: Mass assignment of closed status
threats.description: A citizen may attempt to manipulate protected fields such as closed status.
threats.mitigation: Allow-list editable fields and never accept closed status from the citizen.

data.name:
Create Share Link
(E8)
data.description: E8 Share link creation. Creates the secret link for a report.

threats.title: Predictable share token
threats.description: Predictable tokens could be guessed by attackers.
threats.mitigation: Generate tokens using a cryptographically secure random number generator with sufficient entropy.

threats.title: Create link for another user’s report
threats.description: A citizen could create a share link for a report they do not own if ownership is not checked.
threats.mitigation: Require T5 report-owner authorisation before creating the link.

threats.title: Permanent share token
threats.description: A leaked share token may remain valid indefinitely.

data.name:
Validate Token & Show Report
(E9)
data.description: E9 Share link page. Receives a secret token and shows the matching report if valid.

threats.title: Token enumeration
threats.description: Different responses for invalid and valid tokens may help attackers discover valid tokens.
threats.mitigation: Use generic errors, rate limiting and safe token comparison.

threats.title: Closed report remains accessible
threats.description: A valid token could continue exposing a report if report state is not checked.
threats.mitigation: Re-check report state during share-link authorisation.

data.name: Report Store
data.description: Stores report content, owner association and report status.

threats.title: Unauthorised report disclosure
threats.description: Direct database access could expose sensitive report information.
threats.mitigation: Restrict database access, use least privilege and protect data at rest.

threats.title: Direct report tampering
threats.description: Database access could bypass application authorisation and modify reports.
threats.mitigation: Restrict and audit direct database access.

data.name: Share Token Store
data.description: Stores share tokens and their association with reports.

threats.title: Share tokens stored in usable form
threats.description: Database compromise could expose working bearer credentials.
threats.mitigation: Store a cryptographic hash of the token.

threats.title: No token revocation state
threats.description: Without expiry or revocation, leaked tokens may remain usable.
threats.mitigation: Store and enforce expiry and revocation state.
